Title: Agentic Intelligence for Unified Cyber Defense: A Self-Adaptive Framework for Threat Detection Across Cloud, Edge, and IoT Systems
Takeaway: The Agentic Intelligence Self-Adaptive Framework (AISAF) improves adaptability, robustness, and drift recovery in cyber-attack detection across cloud, edge, and IoT systems, demonstrating potential for autonomous and interpretable cybersecurity systems.

Title: ADAWU-IDS: a dynamic adaptive weight update mechanism for concept drift-aware network intrusion detection systems
Takeaway: ADAWU-IDS is a customizable drift-response framework for network intrusion detection, showing modest improvements over static LSTM but not statistically significant.
Authors: Jin-Liang Yuan, Yu Yang, Mingqi Wang
Journal: Journal of King Saud University Computer and Information Sciences

Title: A Comprehensive Survey on Concept-Drift-Resilient Network Intrusion Detection Systems
Takeaway: Concept-drift-resilient network intrusion detection systems (NIDS) adapt to evolving networks, reducing operational instability and increasing vulnerability.
Authors: Mateus Komarchesqui, V. G. da Silva Ruffo, V. Schiavon, Matheus Riki Nakanishi, Gustavo Hideyuki Kitamura Nishikawa, L. F. Carvalho, M. Proença

Title: Concept drift detection in image data stream: a survey on current literature, limitations and future directions
Takeaway: This survey reviews concept drift detection methods for image data streams, categorizes them based on key properties, and highlights strengths and limitations, identifying promising future research directions.
Authors: Quang-Tien Tran, Nhien-An Le-Khac, Michela Bertolotto
